composition.elementLabel: How do I get started with IAR?

value.message: How do I get started with IAR?

Issue Auto Resolution (IAR) is a Now Platform capability that allows you to deflect or resolve cases without human intervention. You can install the ITSM Virtual Agent Conversations application from the ServiceNow Store to get started with the automation of Incidents or the IAR for HR application to automate your HR cases. After the installation is complete, review and modify the configurations to suit your business needs. Then, activate your settings, and you are good to go.

Any issue created is processed through IAR when an active IAR Configuration exists for the issue type, and it qualifies the specified entry conditions. IAR attempts to identify the requester's intent using Now Intelligence with the case description. We deliver any available matching Virtual Agent conversation to the issue requester in case of an intent match. In addition, IAR provides relevant AI Search results when Virtual Agent topics are not found.

composition.elementLabel: How do I turn IAR on and off?

value.message: How do I turn IAR on and off?

To turn on IAR, navigate to Settings, select a specific IAR configuration, navigate to the configuration form by clicking Edit configuration, then click  Enable IAR in the last step on the configuration form. You can easily turn off any active IAR configuration by clicking the Turn off button on the Settings page.

composition.elementLabel: Does IAR have any impact on Task SLAs?

value.message: Does IAR have any impact on Task SLAs?

All issues are assigned to the bot user while IAR processes it. If you're tracking the SLA of a case based on the assignee, assigning the case to a bot user might impact your SLA. Review and update your SLA definitions based on your requirements before  turning on IAR for any issue.
